classification.question_topic: Concern about vivid Mall World dreams bleeding into waking memory; asks if going crazy / needs neurologist
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene or locations described; only waking-aftereffects and memory confusion.

meta.final_emotion: anxious; feels like going insane; worried about needing neurologist (verbatim: 'I feel like I'm going insane')
meta.author_theory: Two worlds colliding (verbatim: 'The two worlds are starting to collide')

interactions.description: Upon waking from very vivid Mall World dreams, dreamer has to 'smack myself to make sure I am really awake' and has waking memories of being there; can 'barely differentiate between the real world and the mall world anymore.' Remembers conversations from Mall World and begins talking about them to someone, then realizes 'That wasnt this reality, that was my dream reality and that never actually happened.'

entities_involved.description: Someone in waking life responds 'wtf are you talking about?' when dreamer mentions Mall World conversations

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology available is primarily waking-aftereffects (reality confusion, vividness, post-wake self-check). No describable Mall World locations, movement, light, crowds, or boundaries are provided.
